test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

Each of the girls **narrated their** story

options.text: Each of the girls narrated there story
Each of the girls narrated his story
Each of the girls narrated her story
Each of the girls narrated their stories

solution:
The correct answer is '**Each of the girls narrated her story**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is "**Each of the girls**," which is singular.
 
• The corresponding pronoun that aligns with the singular subject is "**her**" because the sentence refers to "**girls**" (females).
 
• **Option 3** is the only grammatically correct choice that adheres to subject-pronoun agreement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Each of the girls narrated **her**__ story."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "there story"** is incorrect because "there" is an adverb, not a possessive pronoun.
 
• **Option 2: "his story"** is incorrect because it does not align with the gender reference to "girls."
 
• **Option 4: "their stories"** is incorrect because it assumes plural narration, while the subject "Each" is singular.
